proposals.before: Guang home with former Yingyin marquis grandson Pingye resided Lantian south mountain middle shot hunted.
proposals.after: Guang's household lived in seclusion with a grandson of the former Marquis of Yingyin in the mountains south of Lantian, where they went hunting.
proposals.reason: 屏野 means 'live in seclusion/retirement,' not a personal name Pingye; the literal misreads it as a name.

proposals.before: But Gan had daughter as crown prince middle person, loved favored, Gan son Yu had favor with crown prince, but liked profit, Li clan Ling declined weakened.
proposals.after: But Gan had a daughter who was a palace woman of the Crown Prince and was favored; Gan's son Yu had favor with the Crown Prince, but liked profit, and the Li clan gradually declined and weakened.
proposals.reason: 陵遲 is the verb 'to decline gradually,' not the personal name Ling; the literal wrongly treats 陵 as Li Ling.

proposals.before: Wu Chu army time, Guang became fierce cavalry commandery governor, followed commander Ya fu attacked Wu Chu army, took flag, displayed merit fame Changyi below.
proposals.after: Wu-Chu army time, Guang became brave-cavalry commandant, followed Grand Commandant Yafu attacking Wu-Chu armies, took a flag, and displayed merit and fame below Changyi.
proposals.reason: 都尉 is commandant, not commandery governor; 太尉亞夫 is Grand Commandant Yafu (Zhou Yafu).

decisions.reason: In s0061, 屏野居 is the verb phrase “lived in seclusion,” not a personal name; the literal’s “Pingye” invents a name between 故潁陰侯孫 and 居藍田南山中, so the repair correctly restores seclusion and hunting with the marquis’s grandson.
In s0157, 陵遲衰微 means the Li clan “gradually declined and weakened”; 陵 is not Li Ling (who only appears in the next sentence 李陵既壯), so replacing “Ling declined” with gradual decline is required.
In s0011, 驍騎都尉 is a cavalry commandant, not a commandery governor, and 太尉亞夫 is Grand Commandant Yafu; the repair corrects both office and title misreadings without inventing content.
